# Ultrastable

> The platform repository: the tick Worker, the site, the dashboard, doctrine, checks and the seed/ kernel are written here. Licence: LicenseRef-Ultrastable-USL-1.0 (source-available, non-commercial use free).

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](agents/AGENTS.md): the operating agreement every agent follows
- [seed/SYSTEM.md](seed/SYSTEM.md): what a system is, generated from its code
- [docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md](docs/PROJECT-MEMORY.md): project memory
- [doctrine/repo-design.json](doctrine/repo-design.json): why the repositories are shaped this way, each answer tied to a probe

## Code

- [foundation/](foundation/): the Python checks and loops (`python3 -m foundation <cmd>`)
- [seed/worker/src/tick.js](seed/worker/src/tick.js): the heartbeat
- [foundation/agent_ladder.py](foundation/agent_ladder.py): the executor's model ladder
